summary: Define domain ownership, data contracts, service levels and value KPIs. Build a practical operating model for reusable data products.
lede: A data product operating model sets out how domain teams own, maintain and support reusable data products for identifiable consumers. For data product managers, BI leaders, platform owners and domain stewards, the course develops practical ways to define ownership and stewardship, draft catalogue entries and data contracts, set service expectations, and track adoption and value. Exercises use Data Mesh principles and Team Topologies to shape artefacts teams can adapt.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who define, deliver or govern reusable data products across business domains. It suits you if you need to clarify ownership, coordinate platform and domain teams, or report whether data services meet consumer needs.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with data, analytics or business intelligence delivery is recommended. You should have experience coordinating with a business or data team; no coding or programming is required. Exercises focus on operating-model documents and metrics rather than platform configuration.
